description:
Export a double-entry reconciled financial statement and paginated order ledger with SHA-256 checksum covering Stripe top-ups, spends, and refunds. Use this for order history pagination and accounting audits; do not use for live balances (x402_get_account) or active key caps (x402_list_delegate_keys).
Parameters: start_date/end_date (inclusive UTC), entry_type, delegate_id, and limit/offset slice rows[] while reconciliation verifies the full ledger; supply spend_key or header (conflicting values return HTTP 400).
Behavior: zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; returns statement_sha256 plus total_matching_rows for pagination, or HTTP 401 on invalid/revoked key.

delegate_id.description: Unique delegated subagent key identifier returned by x402_issue_delegate_key or x402_get_account (format: sbd_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sbd_1122334455667788).

end_date.description: UTC calendar date in ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-11-22).

entry_type.description: Optional ledger row type filter: "all" (default), "spend" (paid capability orders), "topup" (Stripe credits), or "refund".

limit.description: Optional page size capping returned rows[] (1 to 500; omit to return all matching rows).

offset.description: Optional zero-based row offset for paginating order history when paired with limit.

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

start_date.description: UTC calendar date in ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-11-22).

name: x402_export_statement

ok.description: True when the reconciled statement was generated.

balanced.description: True when computed double-entry closing balance matches the ledger balance exactly.

row_count.description: Number of chronological ledger entries included in rows.

rows.description: Chronological ledger entries with USD amounts, routes, payment identifiers, and delegate attribution.

statement_sha256.description: Tamper-evident SHA-256 checksum of the statement payload.

total_matching_rows.description: Total matching rows before applying limit/offset pagination.

title: Export Reconciled Financial Statement
